correctness.rationale: For every n>=4, graph vertices are edges of K_n. Every length-two geodesic of L(K_n) is a three-edge ordinary P4, every such P4 is geodesic, all adjacent pairs extend to length two, and diameter is two. Therefore complements of transversals are precisely ordinary P4-free graphs. Connected P4-free graphs are stars or triangles. Exhaustive classification of edge-saturated P4-free graphs yields the exact facet EGF; the labelled exponential formula gives both cardinality polynomials. Endpoint counts follow from component edge/vertex differences, with explicit matching and triangle/star counts. A separate BFS shortest-path implementation exhaustively checked 33,856 subsets for n=4..6 and both polynomial coefficients. Finite computations are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The complete all-set and irredundant-set size distributions are natural graph-theoretic objects for geodesic hitting in highly symmetric J(n,2). Matching-only minimum cardinality information and an edge-existence spectrum do not answer how many successful or minimally sufficient sensor subsets exist at each cardinality. The result supplies two compact explicit coefficient-extraction formulas, an exact transversal-to-path-saturation identification, and sharp extremal multiplicities for every n>=4.
